description: This file defines tracing event structures, clock types, and tracer classes for logging and resource usage tracking within the ocudu namespace. It includes functions for managing trace files and various event types with associated data, including resource usage snapshots.

classes.name: null_event_tracer
classes.description: A tracer class that does not write any events, used for null tracing when optimizations are enabled.

classes.name: file_event_tracer
classes.description: Template class for writing trace events to a file, specialized for enabled/disabled states.

classes.name: logger_event_tracer
classes.description: Template class that uses a log channel to write trace events, with enabled/disabled specialization.

classes.name: test_event_tracer
classes.description: Class for testing that records trace events into a vector of strings.

methods.name: open_trace_file
methods.description: Opens a trace file for writing trace events, with options for splitting files and event triggers.

methods.name: close_trace_file
methods.description: Closes the currently open trace file.

methods.name: is_trace_file_open
methods.description: Checks if the trace file is currently open.
